note: units a year; amounts are notional (ranks within a good, not across goods). per_good amounts: producers = spare over own demand, customers = deficit, routes = modelled cross-polity flow. polity exports.share = share of the map's net polity surplus.

goods.label: iron
goods.value_note: the commonest metal: tools, arms, nails; good ore (byte 100+) is what a mining town stands on

goods.label: copper
goods.value_note: bronze, wire, roofs, coin

goods.label: tin
goods.value_note: the scarce half of bronze; worth carrying anywhere

goods.label: bronze (copper + tin)
goods.value_note: made where copper and tin meet; bells, fittings, the Hykkousoi and Eternian court metal

goods.label: gold
goods.value_note: coin, leaf, a court's face; value carries any distance

goods.label: silver
goods.value_note: coin (the Mint), plate, the Heirs' rank metal

goods.label: nickel (with platinum)
goods.value_note: steel, armour, Ancient-grade alloys

goods.label: rare earths
goods.value_note: magnets and phosphors to keep Ancient machines and lights running

goods.label: coal
goods.value_note: smelting fuel where wood is short; heavy, so it goes by water

goods.label: oil and petrol
goods.value_note: lamp oil, petrol for buggies, generators and mechs (LORE.md:184 "petrol")

goods.label: salt
goods.value_note: every person and beast needs ~5 kg a year; the oldest long-range good

goods.label: saltpeter
goods.value_note: gunpowder (the Republic's rockets, firearms) and fertiliser

goods.label: sulfur
goods.value_note: gunpowder, medicine, bleach

goods.label: potash
goods.value_note: soap, glass, glazes; scarce on most reaches

goods.label: Ancient scrap metal
goods.value_note: stripped from the ruins: the iron substitute (LORE.md:161, 184)

goods.label: timber
goods.value_note: carried only to treeless places, by water

goods.label: food staples (grain, fish)
goods.value_note: bulk: short range only (routes capped at 250 km)

goods.label: cacao
goods.value_note: cacao, the Vale of Xanadu's fame (LORE.md:500)

goods.label: coffee
goods.value_note: coffee and rattle coffee

goods.label: tea
goods.value_note: mist tea and ivan-chai (the Eternian "tea analogue", LORE.md:742)

goods.label: tropical spice (clove, citron)
goods.value_note: the Spice Isles' trade (LORE.md:70, 435)

goods.label: highland spice (saffron, umbel, juniper)
goods.value_note: grams per head, worth its weight in silver

goods.label: sugar and syrup
goods.value_note: cane, paper-maple syrup, tamarisk manna

goods.label: silk
goods.value_note: mulberry and lotus silk; courts' cloth

goods.label: cotton and ramie
goods.value_note: cloth fibre

goods.label: temperate dyes (woad, broom, lichens, barks)
goods.value_note: the Talovolci's woad-blue (LORE.md:913)

goods.label: myrrh and medicines
goods.value_note: myrrh, rimdew, ginseng (LORE.md:184 "medicines")

goods.label: reagents (camphor, sky poppy)
goods.value_note: the alchemists' and the Monks' stores

goods.label: mounts and hides
goods.value_note: riding beasts and their hides: raptors, spiders, beetles, camels, millipedes (LORE.md:185, 321-353)

goods.label: pearls and nacre
goods.value_note: Hykkousoi divers and mother-of-pearl workers "the finest in the world" (LORE.md:569)

goods.label: almanacs
goods.value_note: Jimjam sells almanacs along the caravan routes; contracts are dated by its reckoning (LORE.md:524, 1059)

goods.label: Jimjam brick and masons
goods.value_note: red and yellow silt brick, laid abroad by Jimjam masons (Dilihan's old quarter); heavy, so short range (LORE.md:515, 267)

goods.label: Xanadu goldwork and prayer wheels
goods.value_note: gold leaf from the Goldsmiths ("the richest house in the valley") and the great prayer wheels (LORE.md:471, 473, 500)

goods.label: rockets and firearms
goods.value_note: the Arsenal's racks of rockets; "the most skilled" at muskets and cannon (LORE.md:187, 295-296)

goods.label: telescopes and lenses
goods.value_note: the Astronomers' Guild at Roketstad grinds lenses from Ancient glass (LORE gives lenses to the Republic, not the Monks) (LORE.md:534, 540)

goods.label: books and copied records
goods.value_note: the Order's archives and copyists (the brief's "books"; LORE says archives and relics, not a book trade) (LORE.md:552, 560)

goods.label: electrics and generators
goods.value_note: Yuni and Locus are "the only fully electrified cities"; the Geomancers' generator on an Ancient engine (LORE.md:166, 400)

goods.label: mech parts and arms
goods.value_note: the Forgemasters keep the mechs; Xanadu's best weapons come from Izizian and Yuni traders (LORE.md:146, 243, 501)

goods.label: gene-craft and healing
goods.value_note: the Genepriests sell modifications (night vision, pressure adaptation, extra limbs); Dalab healers are prized (LORE.md:47, 197)

goods.label: recycled scrap goods
goods.value_note: the abyssal people recycle the ruins "with pride and colour"; tin-mirror cladding, repurposed tanks (LORE.md:163, 391-395)

goods.label: relics
goods.value_note: the capital's relics under the Valley rule: why the caravans cross the Wall (LORE.md:741)

goods.label: porcelain, tile and paper
goods.value_note: a kiln country's wares beside Jimjam's brick: porcelain-grade ceramics, glazed tile, paper (LORE.md:742)

goods.label: Spice Isles spice (re-export)
goods.value_note: Voth took Zey'danin to control the rich Spice Isles; Temora and Zey'danin are the spice ports (LORE.md:435, 440, 461)

goods.label: fungal distillates
goods.value_note: the Zeijani fungal alchemist grows and distils (dark-grown crops need a works, not a climate) (kits/zeijani/PLAN.md:232)

goods.label: checked wool cloth
goods.value_note: Talovolci wool, checked and striped in weld-yellow, woad-blue and madder-red (LORE.md:913)

polities.name: Iron Republic
polities.fix: craft only (rockets, lenses); natural option: tin at 706,628 (25 node-yield, 34 km from Lipp; a Lipp tin mine) would put it beside Yuni and the Eternal State in tin; iron cannot be unique (every polity has good ore), though the best unworked iron on the map is in the Republic at 558,883 (47 node-yield, 86 km from Cascade)

polities.name: Eternal State
polities.fix: craft only (relics, porcelain); natural option: tin at 328,606 (25 node-yield, 76 km from Farport) or the over-sea goods under State monopoly (LORE.md:741) as a third specialty

polities.name: Tungang Union
polities.fix: Cave saltpeter and the Line's salvage. Nitre scraped from the caverns is the classic underground saltpeter: the best saltpeter district in the Tungang Union's polygon is at 492,1255 (25 node-yield, 75 km from Loj Twenny, also inside the Realm of Dalab's polygon). A works pin there, with the Free Giants (63% of the surplus) the only big rival. As a craft, the Tungangs ran the Rift line (LORE.md:153, 221): Ancient cable, rail and tunnel parts salvaged from it are theirs alone. No map edit.

polities.name: Fellgangs
polities.fix: Gold. The unclaimed gold district at 438,1448 (10.5 node-yield, peak 140, 24 km from Wildcat, inside the Fellgangs' polygon; the census's unclaimed list has it at 442,1447). A gold camp pin (or Wildcat's reach widened to 30 km) makes the Fellgangs the only gold seller on the south-western rim; gold is one of the scarcest exports (the Vothic Kingdom and Yuni hold half of it). No map edit.

polities.name: Zeijani
polities.fix: craft only (fungal distillates); natural option: gold and silver at 851,774, 22 km from Dhelv (10.5 and 11.3 node-yield)

polities.name: Jimjam
polities.fix: craft only (almanacs, brick); natural option: gypsum (Jimjam leads the census, 22.4 good-ground node-yield: plaster and alabaster) if gypsum is counted as long-range

polities.name: Screamer Country
polities.fix: Bloodwood red. The bloodwood's sap "is the red of their painted dots" (LORE.md:374; `biomes/hyperjungle` station `north`): a dye only Screamer wood yields, added to `kits/crops` as a `homeOnly` dye of the hyperjungle's north. Second, their millipede ranches (LORE.md:368) as a beast source (longcrawlers for capstans and caravans, LORE.md:185) would lift their 5% of the mounts. The coal at 811,698 (44 node-yield, 57 km from the Hexahedron) is not unique: Iziz and the Beast Riders hold more.

polities.name: Order of Historians
polities.fix: craft only (books); fitting for a monastery

polities.name: Lizardmen
polities.fix: n/a: the Lizardmen never trade or treat (LORE.md:813, 1072); their copper, rare earths and salt lake are reachable only by war

polities.name: Nomad Country
polities.fix: craft only (the Tabisti's scrap goods, shared with Yuni's Locus); natural option: potash at 1262,848 (32 node-yield, 126 km from Mungo) or camels counted apart from mounts

polities.name: Coyote Kingdom
polities.fix: Salt and sulfur. A works at about 1190,463 on the Coyote Kingdom's edge: the good rock salt at 1184,466 (the nearest halite of 100+ to Coyote Canyon, Furrow and Shade, 10 km outside the polygon) beside sulfur at 1194,460 (26 node-yield, inside it). Coyote Canyon (salt 0), Shade (2.4) and Furrow (2.0) are short of salt, so it has customers at once; the Republic and Xanadu buy sulfur. A settlement pin, no map edit; the Coyote Kingdom has no lore yet, so this can be its start.

polities.name: Unaligned settlements
polities.fix: n/a: scattered independents (bandits at Boatmurder, LORE.md:735; outposts)
